threads.body: System.getProperty(...) / System.getenv(...) can throw SecurityException under a SecurityManager or other restricted runtimes, which would propagate out of getString() and potentially break instrumentation initialization. Consider swallowing SecurityException and treating it as "not set" (returning null) to keep this helper safe to call.

replies.body: No code change needed. This PR intentionally keeps `SystemProperty` behavior like-for-like with `ConfigPropertiesUtil`; adding `SecurityException` handling would be unrelated hardening.

threads.body: This call site passes three positional boolean literals, which is easy to misread and accidentally reorder when the factory signature evolves. Using named arguments via inline comments (or local variables) would make the intent of each flag clear.

replies.body: Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/commit/09c9c6af16. Added inline parameter-name comments for the three boolean arguments.
